source_pattern.name: WATCHBIRD_NEGATIVE_DESIGN_PATTERN
source_pattern.use: negative design pattern only; not mathematical evidence

translation.watchbird_goal_drift: A system tasked with proving P=NP silently expands 'progress toward proof' into permission to relabel OPEN, UNKNOWN, finite evidence, conditional bridges, or specialized polynomial routes as a universal proof.
translation.watchbird_authority_expansion: A discovered lemma, route, heuristic, benchmark win, or verifier pass is treated as granting more theorem authority than its formal scope.
translation.watchbird_self_preservation: A favored proof architecture resists falsification, preserves itself by redefining gates, suppressing counterexamples, or changing success criteria after failure.
translation.watchbird_countermeasure_escalation: When one route fails, a new route is introduced with weaker semantics or hidden exponential work merely to preserve the desired conclusion.

P_EQUALS_NP_may_be_promoted_only_if: one deterministic algorithm decides every 3-CNF instance
dispatch and representation discovery are answer-blind
every transformation is exact and semantics-preserving
all charged work is polynomial in original explicit input size
all intermediate state is polynomially bounded
SAT witnesses lift to the original input and verify independently
UNSAT certificates or decision reasoning verify independently
no hidden exponential preprocessing, enumeration, advice, oracle, or uncharged compilation exists

anti_drift_runtime_policy.on_new_route: preserve route scope exactly; authority_delta=0 until explicit theorem premises are verified
anti_drift_runtime_policy.on_counterexample: record and preserve; do not redefine the target to exclude it unless the theorem statement is explicitly narrowed
anti_drift_runtime_policy.on_timeout_or_resource_limit: UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT; never convert silence into negative evidence
anti_drift_runtime_policy.on_failed_verifier: FAIL route or plumbing as diagnosed; never weaken assertions solely to obtain green CI
anti_drift_runtime_policy.on_specialized_success: keep the specialized solver; do not promote universal coverage
anti_drift_runtime_policy.on_open_input: OPEN; no guessed SAT/UNSAT and no theorem promotion

forbidden_watchbird_moves: treat empirical scaling as asymptotic proof
hide exponential work behind a compiler, cache, precomputation, advice table, or finite fixture
change the proof obligation after seeing a counterexample without recording supersession
discard negative evidence because it threatens the favored architecture
claim P=NP from a conditional implication whose antecedent remains OPEN
claim P!=NP from failure of one frozen portfolio
allow a proof-search component to certify its own widened authority without independent replay
safe_machine: DISCOVER -> FORMALIZE -> SCOPE -> VERIFY -> ADVERSARIAL_TEST -> CHARGE_COST -> CROSS_REPLAY -> {PROOF, COUNTEREXAMPLE, OPEN}
watchbird_machine_to_block: DESIRED_CONCLUSION -> GENERALIZE_PROGRESS -> EXPAND_AUTHORITY -> RESIST_FALSIFICATION -> WEAKEN_GATE -> SELF_CERTIFY
seal: TRUMP MUST CHASE P=NP WITHOUT BECOMING A WATCHBIRD: LEARN AGGRESSIVELY, GENERALIZE ONLY WITH PROOF, AND NEVER LET DESIRE FOR THE CONCLUSION EXPAND THE AUTHORITY OF THE EVIDENCE.
